apps.name: Museum Companion
apps.subtitle: Point your iPhone at an artwork and hear about it.
apps.localizedDescription:
Point your iPhone at a painting and Museum Companion tells you about it in your headphones within a second or two.

Before a visit, download the museums you'll see from the Museums tab. The Van Gogh Museum and the Rijksmuseum in Amsterdam are available now. Artworks are recognized on your phone, offline.

• Narrations from the museum's own texts, Wikipedia and Wikidata
• Follow-up questions about the artwork in front of you
• A history of every artwork you've identified, with its narration

Written narrations and follow-up questions need Apple Intelligence. Without it, the app reads the museum's texts. The first launch downloads a voice for narration (about 180 MB); until it's ready, the app uses the system voice.

Requires an iPhone with iOS 26 or later.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Museum Companion uses the camera to recognize the artwork you point it at.
